title: Studio Access pillar: a delegated-admin scope control shows a different value from what the runtime enforces when the key is unset (detail withheld pending maintainer)
body:
Filing gate: ① product defect, reproduced, landing site named. Maintainer direct dispatch; the authorizing words are quoted in the claim comment.

## Summary

In Studio › Access › a permission set › Delegated admin, one scope control displays a state for an unset key that disagrees with the default the delegated-admin gate enforces. An admin who reads the screen misjudges the scope they are delegating.

- Measured 2026-10-27 at `3fcafcd3` by the Studio QA Access card. The PM read both sides of the code.
- The exact control, the direction and the reproduction are **withheld pending maintainer**, per the maintainer's instruction for security defects that are not to be disclosed. The implementer receives them privately.

## Acceptance (public part)

- For an unset key, the control shows exactly what the gate enforces, and a save does not change the effective scope unless the admin changed the control.
- A pin covers the unset case on the display side, tied to the spec default.

## Filing facts

- Business reason: delegated administration is how larger customers hand out admin power safely; the screen must state the delegated scope truthfully.
- Reader who acts: an `os-dev` implementer, dispatched directly by this PM session (`domain:ui`).
- Dedupe: semantic search `delegated admin include subtree shows off when unset but runtime defaults true` on objectstack-ai/objectstack → 3 hits (#26189, #21057, #9730), all closed and none about this display.
- Source: Studio QA run, 2026-10-27, coordinator session `session_01J8VVAkZns5rNnK2rtszzbQ`.
